research.h1: We look at real business websites. Then we publish what we find.
research.lede: MappedSkills Research looks at how businesses are found, measured and converted. Every report says what we checked, when, how many, and where the evidence stops.
research.lead:
THE HEADLINE FINDING

42.5%

More than 4 in 10 audited websites had no observable Google Analytics.
51
no observable Google Analytics
69
the other websites audited
Each square is one audited website. Each row of 12 is one tenth of the sample. The 69 plain squares are every other website audited, as described in the finding.

Among the 120 websites audited, Google Analytics was not observed on 51 (42.5%) and was observable on 67 (55.8%). Two websites were classified as Unable to Determine.

n=120 Indian business websites · MSR-001 Audit Protocol v1.1. Publicly observable infrastructure only.
research.report:
01
THE FULL REPORT

The Marketing Measurement Gap: What 120 Indian Business Websites Reveal About Analytics and Advertising Measurement

Among the 120 Indian business websites audited, more than 4 in 10 had no observable Google Analytics, yet 97.5% preserved the UTM parameters used in testing.

Published
October 5, 2026
Research period
2025-2026
Geography
India
Sample size
120
Category
Industry Benchmarks
Author
Amit Gupta
Read the full report
Methodology
Limitations

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOU

If your website can’t see where visitors come from, it’s hard to tell which marketing brings enquiries.

WHAT IT DOESN’T MEAN

It doesn’t mean these businesses had no measurement at all. Some may use tools that can’t be seen from outside.
